ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 75% of the visible surface, primarily in the central lobe regions, contrasted against a low-intensity (black) peripheral border and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit large, contiguous high-intensity white fields; a continuous low-intensity black border follows the trailing edge and encompasses the distal tips; irregular black mottling is concentrated along the inner margins of the trailing edge and near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle estimated at 35-45 degrees, showing a sharp convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; notably sharper and more pronounced jaggedness on the outer halves of both lobes reaching the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent convex curve from the median notch to the tips; distal tips show a distinct downward and inward hook-like curvature (convexity).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of small, circular, low-intensity spots on the far right distal tip; smaller, isolated dark spots scattered across the lower white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, dark, high-contrast linear mark is visible on the left lobe, extending roughly 15% of the lobe's width from the trailing edge inward toward the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant dark linear scar on the outer portion of the left lobe; irregular jagged missing sections on the right lobe's trailing edge distal to the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The black pigmentation along the trailing edge is unusually thick and characterized by 'bleeding' or irregular finger-like extensions into the primary white field.
